info.title: Shirubasoft Aspire Modular AppHosts Tool
info.description: Workflow image manifest tooling for Aspire modular AppHosts.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Workflow tooling for Aspire modular AppHosts.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: manifest
commands.description: Creates and consumes workflow image manifests.

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Publishes selected images and writes their remote identities.

options.name: --apphost
options.description: AppHost project path or containing directory.

options.name: --selector
options.description: Module or resource selector. Repeat for multiple selections.

options.name: --all
options.description: Publish every module image exposed by the AppHost. [default: False]

options.name: --tag
options.description: Tag applied to every selected image.

options.name: --resource-tags
options.description: Per-resource tags as a JSON object keyed by <module>/<resource>. [default: {}]

options.name: --output
options.description: Manifest output path.

options.name: --aspire-path
options.description: Aspire CLI executable path. [default: aspire]

commands.name: apply
commands.description: Runs a command with workflow image identities applied.

options.name: --file
options.description: Manifest file path.

options.name: --json
options.description: Inline compact manifest JSON.

options.name: --tag
options.description: Tag applied to every manifest image.

options.name: --resource-tags
options.description: Per-resource tags as a JSON object keyed by <module>/<resource>. [default: {}]

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: Command and arguments to run with the manifest configuration; precede them with '--'.

commands.name: dispatch
commands.description: Dispatches a workflow, waits for it, and returns its result.

options.name: --repository
options.description: Target repository in [HOST/]OWNER/REPO form.

options.name: --workflow
options.description: Target workflow file name, ID, or name.

options.name: --ref
options.description: Target branch or tag containing the workflow. Defaults to the repository default branch.

options.name: --manifest
options.description: Module image manifest file passed to the target workflow.

options.name: --manifest-input
options.description: Target workflow input that receives the manifest. [default: image-manifest]

options.name: --input
options.description: Additional workflow input in <name>=<value> form. Repeat for multiple inputs.

options.name: --gh-path
options.description: GitHub CLI executable path. [default: gh]
